title: Query duration change between samples
description: For each database_name ordered by sampled_seq ASC, sample_id ASC, derive previous_duration_ms with LAG and delta_ms = duration_ms - previous_duration_ms. For the first row of each database both values must be NULL. Return exactly six columns: sample_id, database_name, sampled_seq, duration_ms, previous_duration_ms, delta_ms. Final sort: database_name ASC, sampled_seq ASC, sample_id ASC.
starter_sql:
SELECT sample_id, database_name, sampled_seq, duration_ms
FROM query_stats
hints: A CTE can compute previous_duration_ms once before deriving delta_ms.
solution_explanation: LAG exposes the previous sample in the same database; subtraction naturally yields NULL for the first row.
